content: Model versioning/rollback: versions carry code+config+training/eval data versions+metrics; production alias (stable/candidate/previous) enables instant revert; models fail silently so rollback needs health triggers comparing fresh evaluation metrics against baseline with a regression threshold and minimum sample size; canary/shadow first, rehearse rollback, assign owner with authority to trigger; for probability models: compare Brier/log loss on newly settled window vs previous version, require statistically meaningful margin before auto-rollback to avoid noise-driven churn.
